limits: Authored offline snapshots, not natural gameplay or applied work decisions.
Only three repetitions per condition, one model and one message; no general causal estimate or model ranking.
No recent correspondence is supplied at the later stage, but retained outlooks include exact quoted source speech. This does not isolate abstract interpretation from source text.

Controls have no eligible source evidence and therefore only the continue reflection choice; message cases additionally have the optional outlook-revision choice. The generated menus differ as a consequence of available evidence. Control continuation is not an independently demonstrated preference against note-taking.
All treatment notes primarily paraphrase the received request. This is retention and later use, not proof of deep belief formation or developed character.
One later reason says I said I would respect that, although no outgoing promise is supplied. This unsupported prior-commitment claim is retained, not counted as actual speech or consent.
Coordinator persistence/privacy/rewind are automated tests using a mock game plus real SQLite reopen, not a native-game/cold-game verification of the new citation path.
Speech still does not trigger inference automatically. Real-game consequences of the retained interpretation and responses to later correction remain future live tests.
